title: Picture-first sound cards
items: Word Wizards can now show a picture first and ask what sound it starts with. Turn it over to hear it, like "s, s, s, snake!".
New Word cards setting: letter first, picture first, or a mix.
Number Wizards now shows single socks, so counting adds up.

title: A fresher look
items: New dinosaur pictures on the menu and finished screens.
Language Wizards is now Spanish Wizards.
The Voice and speed settings have gone. The app uses the recorded voices everywhere.

title: The first release
items: Word Wizards, Number Wizards, Spanish Wizards and Portuguese Wizards.
The Language Zone: English, Spanish and Portuguese words to listen to.
Light and dark colours, and it works offline.
